title: stackfoundry manifest (.stackfoundry/manifest.lock.json)
description: Written by `stackfoundry manifest record`. What init generated, from which template and version, and the hash it had when written, so upgrade can tell untouched files from edited ones.

template.description: Plugin-relative template path, or 'research' for a file generated from a researched pack.

sha256.description: Of the content with line endings normalized to LF.

kind.description: merged: the team's content is in it too (merged by hand or kept by choice); upgrade and research-stack always ask before changing it.
